_note: Pre-registered 2026-11-11 (04:30 ET), BEFORE the collector for this source was built and before any signal of this source was recorded or any return was seen. Do not edit to fit a result. To change a rule, add a dated entry to docs/research/log.md saying why, then edit.
purpose: Fast, high-volume feedback from the oldest anomaly that still needs only daily prices: short-term reversal (last week's biggest losers bounce, winners give back). Evidence for, from memory and NOT re-read: Lehmann 1990, Jegadeesh 1990; stronger when volatility is high (Nagel 2012). Evidence against: it is weak in large caps after costs, which is exactly what this tests at a realistic size.
data: IBKR daily TRADES bars (regular hours) for the universe and SPY.
event_rule: On the last trading day of each calendar week, after the close: for each universe symbol passing the liquidity filter, R5 = close(today) / close(5 trading days earlier) - 1, minus SPY's return over the same closes. Liquidity filter: At the close of the signal day: close at least 5.00 USD and 20-day average dollar volume over the 20 trading days before it at least 5,000,000 USD (IBKR daily TRADES bars). Failures and missing bars are counted and reported.
signal_rule: The 10 symbols with the lowest R5 get long signals (+1); the 10 with the highest R5 get short signals (-1). Ties are broken by symbol order. Fewer than 40 scorable symbols that evening: no signals, reported.
emission: Recorded by the evening job of that day, after 16:20 ET; event_id is that day (YYYYMMDD); price is the close. A missed evening is lost, never recorded late.
timing: Entry is the open of the first trading day strictly after the ledger date.
ledger: horizons 1, 5 and 21 trading days against SPY; primary horizon 5
multiplicity: Six ledger sources now run at once (insider_cluster_v1, claude_earnings_v1, insider_opportunistic_v1, earnings_reaction_v1, analyst_actions_v1, weekly_reversal_v1). This source needs t above 2.7 (about a one-sided 5% test split six ways, Bonferroni). Earlier sources keep their registered thresholds; read any pass with six in mind.

pass_all_of: mean net excess return at 5 days (direction-adjusted) above 0.3% after the 20 bps cost
t-statistic of the 5-day net excess returns above 2.7
positive mean net excess in BOTH chronological halves of the scored signals
fewer than 10% of signals unscorable 30 trading days after their horizon
reported_not_criteria: weeks with VIX above vs below its trailing 1-year median

known_limits: 20 signals a week are correlated within a week (same market moves), so the t-statistic overstates the evidence; the week-level mean is reported alongside.
The universe is today's S&P 500, so stocks that later leave the index are still traded: fine for a forward test.
Short signals assume the stock can be borrowed.
if_fail: Report it as a failure and stop spending effort on short-term reversal.
if_pass: Not proof and not real money: a second independent period, a realistic-size execution check, then evidence/gate.json.
